_comment: Which hosts a Markdown reader may fetch images from without asking (MarkdownDocumentView with showsImages, first used by StoryMaker's Read view, 2026-10-03). Opening a chapter must not ping an arbitrary server: an image from any host not listed here renders as a link instead, the way mail readers hold back remote images. Local files always load. Content, so a host is added by PR with no rebuild. thumb.wikimedia.org added 2026-10-04: the Commons API now returns its scaled copies (thumburl) from that host, so four of the pilot's six pictures rendered as links. Seattle city feeds added 2026-10-11 (spdblotter, fireline, sdotblog .seattle.gov): the Seattle Local News routine shows up to two photos from the city's own feeds, credited and linked to the story; the iPhone's AI Write reader now loads pictures under these same rules. Neighborhood outlets serve photos from shared CDNs (i0.wp.com, S3) and are deliberately NOT listed — trusting a CDN host trusts every site on it.
